# Posts Module Mocks

This directory contains auto-generated mocks for the posts module's repository interfaces.

##  Important: DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

All files in this directory are **auto-generated by mockery**. Any manual changes will be overwritten.

## Generating Mocks

### Regenerate Posts Mocks Only

```bash
make mocks-posts
```

### Regenerate All Mocks

```bash
make mocks
```

## Available Mocks

- `MockUserPostRepository` - For user posts management
- `MockCommentRepository` - For post comments management

## Usage in Tests

```go
import (
    "github.com/basilex/promenade/internal/modules/posts/domain/repository/mocks"
)

func TestPostUseCase_CreatePost(t *testing.T) {
    // Create mock
    mockRepo := new(mocks.MockUserPostRepository)

    // Set expectations
    mockRepo.On("Create", mock.Anything, mock.AnythingOfType("*entity.UserPost")).Return(nil)

    // Use in test...
    mockRepo.AssertExpectations(t)
}
```

## When to Regenerate

Run `make mocks-posts` after:

- Adding new methods to repository interfaces
- Changing method signatures
- Modifying return types
